title: Roast Prime Rib
tagline: A standing rib roast seared hot, then roasted at 350° with frequent basting.

items: 1 rib roast of beef, bone in, with a thick layer of fat
A few tablespoons of water, if the roast is large

steps.text: Rub a rib roast of beef with salt and spread it generously with butter or fat.
Put it on a rack in a roasting pan, resting on the bone ends. Needs a thick layer of fat (or beef suet).
Sear in a very hot oven (450°) for about 20 minutes.
Reduce the heat to moderate (350°) and continue to roast, basting frequently, until done: 16 minutes per lb. for rare, 20 minutes per lb. for medium, 23 minutes per lb. for well done.
If large, add a few tablespoons of water to the pan to prevent the fat from burning.
Remove meat to a large platter and let stand 10 minutes.
